description: This is the main activity source file for an Android application demonstrating SwipeRefreshLayout usage. It manages a fragment container, options menu, and logging setup.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The primary activity class that initializes the UI, manages fragment transactions, options menu, and logging for the app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and adds the SwipeRefreshLayoutBasicFragment if savedInstanceState is null.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from XML.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the options menu, showing or hiding the log toggle based on view type.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, toggling log view visibility.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain with wrappers and filters, and links to a LogFragment for on-screen logs.
